title: Glowing avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffaa' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffee55' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='pit' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8813a'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#8B4513'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6B3410'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='44' ry='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- avocado outer skin - dark green outside -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='32' ry='40' fill='#2d5a1e'/>

  <!-- inner flesh - light yellow-green -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='34' fill='#b8e04a'/>

  <!-- bright inner rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='23' ry='31' fill='#d4f05e'/>

  <!-- pit -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='12' fill='url(#pit)'/>

  <!-- pit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='57' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8a85c' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- cute face on the flesh above the pit -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='3' fill='#1a3a10'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='3' fill='#1a3a10'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 53 58 46' stroke='#1a3a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='44' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8866' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='44' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8866' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <g fill='#ffffcc'>
    <path d='M18 25 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5-4 l-4-1.5 l4-1.5 z' opacity='0.8'/>
    <path d='M82 20 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1-3 l-3-1 l3-1 z' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M85 70 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1-2.5 l-2.5-1 l2.5-1 z' opacity='0.6'/>
    <path d='M15 72 l0.8 2 l2 0.8 l-2 0.8 l-0.8 2 l-0.8-2 l-2-0.8 l2-0.8 z' opacity='0.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
